compiled_state.title: As a reconciler operator, I want conflict_resolver.py to track per-element provenance across scalar and collection element classes
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Extend conflict_resolver.py (preserved from 3a03) with per-element provenance. For each syncable element class — scalars (title, description, status, priority, type, assignee) and collections-with-provenance (comments, labels excluding dso-id-*, watchers, links) — the resolver records originating side and timestamp of each element. On next pass, resolver uses provenance to decide whether an apparent delta is a true bidirectional update or an echo of its own prior write.
**Why**: Without per-element provenance, a comment added on Jira and one added locally would echo back as duplicate writes on subsequent passes; sc-11 and (transitively) sc-12 unprovable without it.
**Scope**:
- IN: conflict_resolver per-element provenance, 6-case test matrix (a-f from sc-11), echo-suppression test
- OUT: Persistent provenance storage (forbidden by sc-2 statelessness); cross-pass provenance is derived per-pass

## Done Definitions

- For each of the 4 scalar element classes (title, description, priority, assignee) and each of the 4 collection element classes (comments, labels excluding dso-id, watchers, links), a create/edit/delete bidirectional test against throwaway DIG issues applies exactly once per pass and emits zero mutations across 3 consecutive follow-on passes; one test case per element class ← Satisfies: sc-11
- For scalar status and type element classes, bidirectional create/edit applies exactly once and emits zero mutations across 3 follow-on passes (delete is N/A); test covers both classes ← Satisfies: sc-11
- Per-element provenance records both side-of-origin and timestamp; unit test serializes provenance for a representative element collection and asserts both fields are present for every element ← Satisfies: sc-11, sc-12
- An echo-suppression test: a write applied on pass N to the local side does not produce a corresponding outbound mutation on pass N+1; test asserts manifest on pass N+1 contains zero mutations for the touched element ← Satisfies: sc-11, sc-12
- Unit tests written and passing for all new logic ← Validates Closure Check: "TDD DoD"

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Provenance must be derivable from per-pass state (no persistent storage); otherwise sc-2 stateless convergence is violated.
- [Performance] Collection-with-provenance comparisons are O(elements * passes); ensure conflict_resolver hashes element bodies rather than re-fetching them each pass.
- [Split-candidate] Foundation (scalar element classes) / Enhancement (collection element classes) split may be applied during implementation-plan if the 6-case test matrix grows unwieldy.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
